notes.title: Weekly Update #16 - Let's Talk About Act 4 & Release Dates
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/4436db186c9e45d7ca304d07f424b6f4a37e5d77.gif

It’s Gamescom week, Parasites, and this week’s update is the largest one to date. We’ve got a ton of stuff to get through including new content (did we mention Act 4 is now complete?), what’s happening at Gamescom, release date news and much more. Shall we begin?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/74f3a0af6908e2804948be1efc257506cdfd2614.gif

What’s NEW in 0.1908.1

Completed Act 4: The Desert.
Completed The Desert level.
Added new themed rooms to The Desert.
Added new secrets to The Desert.
Added Area 81 sublevel with new character classes, themed rooms, traps, secrets etc.
Added a brand new character class (as playable and AI character): the Alien Creature.
Added a brand new character class (as playable and AI character): the Researcher.
Updated & added character descriptions in the Almanac. 

FIXED
Fixed quicksand traps.
Fixed Space Huntress’ primary attack.
Fixed Space Huntress’ special attack.
Fixed Pyromaniac’s special attack.
Fixed characters’ GUI.
Fixed Werewolf Pre Attack (as miniboss).
Fixed miniboss rooms unlocking behavior.
Fixed some Old Sewers rooms.
Fixed Third Boss shop room.
Fixed Fourth Boss shop room.

NEW TRAILER ALERT FOR ACT 4!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vhh7Fcds_B4&feature=youtu.be

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/ba968bd9a44056400506677e225619d1b8a131d4.gif

Gamescom 2019

We’re here! We made it to Gamescom and Saverio (the boss Parasite here at Troglobytes HQ) is on hand with this brand new build of HyperParasite. Everything above is ready and waiting.  We can’t wait to show press, influencers and visitors what we have been working on implementing. Come and visit us in Hall 10.1 in the Entertainment Area of the Spanish Pavilion. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33190580/014783816343cf2128cb3b252805485f32020bbb.jpg

Release Date Update + New Price

Since we released HyperParasite on Steam Early Access, the game has received weekly updates including two complete brand new acts, developer and community gameplay streams, a shit ton of new characters, levels, mini-bosses, BIG bosses, gameplay mechanics and quality of life features. As we continue to add more and more to the game, we feel it’s now the right time to increase the price from $10.99 to $12.99. Boss Parasite Saverio released the following statement to the video game press earlier today; 

“With the implementation of Act 4, we feel it’s the right time to increase the price from $10.99 to $12.99, which we feel still offers incredible value for money. If you’re at Gamescom, we’d love to show you how far our game has come along in development since our initial Early Access release!”

In addition to the pricing update, we’re also announcing that our planned full, and final, release for HyperParasite will now be Q1 2020. This gives our team the time required to complete not just the Steam build, but the Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch build too. We’ll continue to keep you updated here via the Steam store page and here on Twitter. 

Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/838110/HyperParasite/

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/17531bc104659dbb815b96d81c98f16636eac4e8.gif

WEEKLY STREAM
It’s Gamescom week, so things are MAD busy here. We’ll be doing our best to do some live streaming here on Steam, so keep an eye on our Twitter account for live updates. 

Don’t forget to follow us on Twitch too!

If you’re a streamer on Mixer, and want to be hosted by Hound Picked’s new channel, whilst getting hands on with HyperParasite, then let us know hyperparasite@houndpicked.com. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/0ed2ccefdae60f979600cdf6a09760ccc6352533.gif

COMMUNITY NEWS

Don’t forget about the brand new HyperParasite Wiki, which went live last week, thanks to our friends over at GamePedia. Since launch, it’s been updated with all the character descriptions and weapon info, with more to come in the following weeks.  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/a1baed1d03a759f0952b36395bfc86c6cecb6bc0.gif

Are you following us on social media? If not, don’t forget you can find the HyperParasite invading host bodies on…

Make sure you get this looked at over on Discord, and become a part of the outbreak on the ground floor.

We still have big work to do around The Furnace mode, scoring systems & stuff and we should have 3 more awesome songs coming in the June Update. Also, your support has been incredible so far, be sure that we're listening to your feeback! It's far from over and the Story mode is also making good progress among the team.

Here are the patchnotes you may have missed! As you can see we improved the game a lot and it is MUCH MORE STABLE now :)

notes.title: Announcing HELLGATE UPDATE + Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/1547942806647a08004a32694001b4c7167e41f4.gif

Hello Headbangers! We’re revealing our next update the HELLGATE UPDATE. It may come at the end of May along with the slick prototype of the Infinite Mode. We’re also revealing our Roadmap in today’s post!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/b4ee343ba8d73186ff8e54bf91b55a849ffaf2ac.png

Early Access Roadmap

We’re super careful about announcing dates so please, please DON’T TAKE THIS FOR GRANTED. Game development is a rocky craft that always takes more time than planned. We truly believe in being open but it also means potential delays.

Here is the order of our NON GRANTED BUT WANTED updates:


Hellgate Pack 1 + Alpha Infinite Mode
Hellgate Pack 2 + Beta Infinite Mode
Infinite mode v1.0 + Chapter 4 
Hellgate Pack 3
Chapter 5 
Hellgate Pack 4
Chapter 6 (and thus, 1.0 Release = out of early access)
(to be decided…)


We’re also continuously improving the UI & UX because we still have feedback around that.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/825c6062c13b532ad121dcfd73c95dfd512208dd.png

THE HELLGATE OPENS SOON

Our first big update will be the opening of the HELLGATE! The first two bands to get introduced in the Hellgate are Hell In Town with Cold and The Fundamental Wisdom Of Chaos and their song The Scarecrow Paradox. It’s only the beginning because we are talking with even bigger bands to get them in the game!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/039c0abc902a552893dd761d6e5138c528db8fad.png

The Hellgate is a much more complete and “safe” experience, a bit like you could enjoy in Guitar Hero! It’s a bit more expensive for us but it ensure that good bands with good levels are in the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/26b926624c86c3fd8e540f9b5d05e979e21a8560.png
(Work in Progress and not DEFINITIVE, please don’t take it as granted)

TO THE INFINITE AND BEYOND

Blackmagic & Gyhyom are working on a new game mode that some of you may heard about. We're calling it "Infinite mode" right now, but is it metal enough?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/aab0788936d89c934e578a9ae5bd972615aaaf8f.gif

We still have a lot of undecided options on this mode such as if we should make short version of music tracks to make this mode "faster". But the prototype is already being started so hopefully, we can show something within the next weeks or so.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27976788/5d4e214a6c1adeb18ae8c871afadfdee9c341ec5.png

To finish, I’d say this is a big push from the team who wants to diversify the game and make it even more appealing for different kind of. This is only the sprout of what could be a great tree (a gloomy death tree, obviously).

Cheers,
Tavrox, CM.
